q: The Jarzynski equality relates the non-equilibrium work W done in a process to the equilibrium free energy difference ΔF by:
exp: Jarzynski equality (1997): ⟨e^{−βW}⟩ = e^{−βΔF} exactly, even far from equilibrium. By Jensen's inequality (e^x convex), ⟨W⟩ ≥ ΔF, recovering the second law as a special case.
